LOOK: Tombs at Peralta Cemetery in Hagonoy, Bulacan, remain submerged in floodwaters on Monday, October 27, despite the absence of rain—just days before the observance of All Souls’ Day. 

Residents have protested millions of pesos’ worth of alleged “ghost” flood control projects in the town, saying these failed to ease persistent flooding. 

📷: Santi San Juan/MB

[8:12AM]  #LagAbkExpWay
#3MB
#TrafficUpdate

Traffic is still an encouraging flow coming inward Otedola bridge from Berger en route Emergency centre.
It's a bit steady at the Tollgate due to vehicular turning, and it's also slow at 7up/Ikosi bus stop own to the activities of commercial buses activities at the bus stop.

Moving ahead to Estate down to Ifako and Car wash is better.
A bit slow approaching Iyana Oworo due to the early morning influx of Vehicular flow and bus stop activities.

It's a gradual flow on the stretch of the Third mainland heading inward Adekunle and Adeniji.

Traffic moves slowly connecting Osborne road through Dolphin due to alternation.

The return journey on the Third mainland bridge back to Tollgate and Berger is good.

Patuloy ang pagtutulungan ng MMDA Western Traffic Enforcement District (WTED) at Manila Traffic and Parking Bureau (MTPB) ngayong araw laban sa mga iligal na nakaparadang sasakyan sa Maynila ilang araw bago ang paggunita ng Undas ngayong taon.

Partikular na in-operate ng grupo ang mga sumusunod na kalsada:

- North Cemetery
- Leonora St. 
- Bambang St. 

Sa operasyon, 14 ang nahatak na mga sasakyan at dinala sa MMDA impounding site sa Tumana, Marikina.

#mmda
